cases.mechanism_detail: G-quadruplexes form in the hexamer and VNTR of the XDP SVA in patient fibroblasts and NPCs; stabilising them with ligands reduced TAF1 transcripts around/downstream of the SVA and increased upstream ones, while unfolding G4s increased TAF1 transcripts, implicating G4s as a cause of aberrant TAF1 expression.
cases.quote: Our data indicate that G4 formation in the XDP SVA is a major cause of aberrant TAF1 expression, opening the way for the development of strategies to unfold G4s and potentially target the disease.
